messages:
kevin: quick one — ACME (enterprise) asked for a blended per-token rate if they commit to 100k reserved tokens/month + rollover unused credits across months, and a hard overage cap. They want this in writing by EOW. need product input on feasibility and launch constraints

maria: high-level Qs: do they mean 'reserved capacity' (dedicated GPU pool) or prepaid credits on hosted? we need their usage profile + requested SLOs. @sasha can you confirm sales intake details?

sasha: they explicitly said reserved capacity (dedicated). sales note: they plan steady traffic but big month-to-month variance. also asked for SLA on p50/p95 latency (p95 <= 200ms).

devin: finance POV: rollover affects revenue recognition and churn math. we can offer a 3-month carry-forward window but it needs a minimum commit term (6mo). hard overage cap is okay if we cap it as a monthly multiplier (eg: up to 150% of committed spend) and charge a higher overage rate. blended rate needs a clear formula.

maria: product tradeoffs: dedicated is billed as capacity (node/slot) not strict "per-token" — tokens are orthogonal. options we can propose to ACME:
- Option A: monthly commit + monthly token credits (no rollover) + standard overage rate
- Option B: monthly commit + token credits with 3mo rollover + slightly higher commit discount
- Option C: monthly commit + guaranteed burst cushion + capped overage at premium rate + performance SLA (only if pinned nodes)
We need launch criteria: 1) documented billing formula, 2) legal T&Cs for rollover/expiry, 3) finance sign-off on rev recognition, 4) ops runbook for capacity/fallback.

kevin: sales pushing for B (rollover) — ACME says rollover is a must to close this quarter. they will sign if we can do 3mo carry and a blended rate communicated.

maria: we can provisionally offer B but require: 6mo minimum term, usage baseline (CSV of last 6 months), and SLA only on pinned dedicated nodes + canary rollout. fallback policy must be in contract (auto failover to hosted compatible variant). also require clause: credits expire on termination.

devin: add note: overage cap clause should say "customer liability capped at 150% of monthly committed spend per billing period". blended-rate example in intake: `blended = commit_rate * (1 - commit_discount) + overage_share * overage_rate` — that's a placeholder, we'll populate numbers once we have usage.

maria: next steps: kevin — get ACME to send last 6 months usage CSV + target latency SLO today. i'll draft a 3-option pricing proposal and circulate to finance/legal. target ETA: EOD Friday for an internal proposal.

kevin: on it. pinging them now with intake link: https://redwood.internal/sales/intake-form — will update thread. :thumbsup:

pricing-bot: Automated calc preview: for 100k commit sample, provisional blended rate ~= $0.006/token with a 10% commit discount (sample only).

sasha: quick backlog note: adding ticket `product: rollover credits for reserved capacity` — priority P2, depends_on finance/legal. tagging @maria.

maria: sounds good. i'll spin up an RFC template after we get the CSV. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
